the IT service companies are using social media to build their brand awareness, to provide customer services, to build relationships with customers, to promote new products and services, and to recruit employees.

IT service companies' marketing efforts on social media can be improved by paying more attention to their customers' expectations.

social media marketing of IT services companies is more about the experience of social media than the content of social media, and it is about the experience of familiarity rather than the experience of novelty.
